question: Users are reporting slowness when accessing certain volumes with extremely high-performance requirements via NFSv3 on a four-node switched NetApp ONTAP cluster. Other volumes on the same cluster are behaving normally. Investigation reveals that there is a high amount of throughput recorded for the cluster LIFs. What action enables you to determine which volumes are affected? A. View the active CIFS sessions on the cluster to determine the affected workloads. B. Check the NFS file locking lease period for the affected volumes. C. Review NFS export policies to ensure that client subnets are listed for the affected volumes. D. View the NFS connected client information and review the “Remote-Reqs” counter.
